name: flue-loom
description: Talk to Flue 2 agents over their conversation URLs: send messages, wait for replies, read transcripts, abort work.
long_description: Flue Loom connects Claude to agents built with Flue (https://flueframework.com), locally under `vite dev` or deployed. Register agent mounts once (with credentials read from FLUE_* environment variables), then send messages and follow durable conversations by id. Part of the flue-loom Claude Code plugin.

registry_dir.title: Agent registry directory
registry_dir.description: Where agents.json (registered agent mounts) lives. Shared with the Claude Code plugin by default.

project_dir.title: Local Flue project
project_dir.description: Optional: a Flue project whose app.ts mounts should be discoverable by name.

base_url.title: Local dev server URL
base_url.description: Where the local project is served (vite dev).

flue_token.title: Bearer token (FLUE_TOKEN)
flue_token.description: Optional token for protected agent routes. Register agents with token_env "FLUE_TOKEN" to send it.

tools.name: flue_list_agents
tools.description: List registered agents and the local project's app.ts mounts

tools.name: flue_add_agent
tools.description: Register a named agent mount URL with optional FLUE_* credential variables

tools.name: flue_send_message
tools.description: Send a message or signal to an agent conversation and wait for the reply

tools.name: flue_read_reply
tools.description: Wait for or fetch the reply to an earlier submission

tools.name: flue_get_conversation
tools.description: Read a conversation transcript with tool calls and outcomes

tools.name: flue_abort
tools.description: Abort running and queued work in a conversation
